description: On the table in front of you there’s a white paper cup with a toothbrush inside it, and a small tube of toothpaste lying nearby. The right hand reaches into the cup to grasp the toothbrush and lifts it out, while the left hand slides in to pick up the toothpaste tube; the left hand twists off the cap and brings the tube over the toothbrush head held in the right hand, squeezing toothpaste onto the bristles before both hands lower the items back toward the table and the toothbrush returns into the cup.
